title: The Horace experiment · ET-SoC-1
description: Same matmul, same FLOPs: 38 W on zeros, 47 W on ones and 63 W on random data on aifoundry2's card, in the same order on a second card. RTL switching counts predict the power to 0.5 W rms; on aifoundry2 a flips-to-temperature model predicts the time from 80 to 90 °C of held-out runs to 9% in the median; 14 structured matrices were priced before they ran (0.9 W rms); and one scale factor carries the power model to the second card.
